CommunityApplications.Profile: Chirp: bird and bat call detection for your yard. Raspberry Pi stations identify birds with BirdNET; the Chirp server keeps recordings, spectrograms, a life list and alerts, and serves the web app and the Chirp iPhone app. This repository holds the Chirp server template plus two optional companions (Chirp-Headscale and Chirp-Caddy) for reaching stations away from home. Support: https://forums.unraid.net/topic/201069-support-joshsalvi-chirp-bird-and-bat-call-detection/ (help pages: https://ourchirp.com/support.html)
